mutations.because: The LAYER_DRAWERS dispatch table must register the html layer drawer so that templates with an html layer can render their backup image on the canvas rather than throwing.

mutations.before: `NodeCanvasCompositor: layer kind "${kind}" has no drawer in this compositor — it draws image, video, shade, accent, static-text, animated-text, logo and html only`,
mutations.after: `NodeCanvasCompositor: layer kind "${kind}" has no drawer in this compositor — it draws image, video, shade, accent, static-text, animated-text and logo only`,
mutations.because: The error message in drawLayer must list html among the supported layer kinds when an unknown kind is encountered, keeping diagnostic messages accurate for unsupported layers.
drawLogo must allow rendering when anchor is undefined if the template has an html layer, allowing canonical image-html templates with a logo to render without requiring a static-text layer.
GenerateCampaignUseCase must not reject image-html creative types at the boundary guard now that the compositor has an HTML layer drawer to produce backup renditions.
The drawHtml drawer must handle button elements by rendering the rounded button background with brandColor and drawing the button text label onto the canvas.
The drawHtml drawer must render image elements using the prepared background asset into the element's bounding box frame.
